records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:82 passes an integer user_id to group.users.delete, which expects User model instances and may raise instead of removing the member
records.rationale: The diff shows in app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb line 82: `group.users.delete(user_id)` where user_id is obtained from `params.require(:user_id).to_i`. The ActiveRecord `delete` method on a has_many association typically expects record objects or IDs, but the behavior can vary. In Rails, `collection.delete(id)` on a has_many :through or has_and_belongs_to_many may not work as expected
